newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Chretien confident of win in home seat.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Chretien confident of win in home seat.

text.p: Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien said on Thursday that he is confident of being re-elected in his home district of Saint-Maurice, Quebec in the national June 2 election.
"The majority voted for me, they voted nine times for me and are ready to vote a 10th time," Chretien said during an open-line television program broadcast on the French-language TVA network.

Polls have showed Chretien in a right race for the riding with Bloc Quebecois candidate Yves Duhaime. In the 1993 federal election, Chretien won the seat with 54.1 percent of the popular vote after opinion polls showed him lagging the Bloc candidate late in the campaign.
